items.t: Pinterest (PINS) Could Be 29% Undervalued After Downgrade Raises New Questions
items.sum: Pinterest (PINS) is drawing attention after a downgrade that cited AI chatbots as a potential threat to its discovery model and questioned how heavy stock-based pay affects its free cash flow profile. Pinterest shares have come under pressure, with the 30 day share price return down 20.81% and the year to date share price return down 33.40%, while the 1 year total shareholder return is down 30.60%

items.t: Pinterest (PINS) Stock Trades Expensive Against Current Earnings
items.sum: Pinterest has seen its share price fall sharply in recent years, which puts fresh focus on whether what investors are paying today lines up with the earnings the business is generating. With that backdrop, the question is how the current valuation stacks up against what the company is actually earning from its visual discovery platform.
